analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see stance for 2 consecutive sessions. RSI rose slightly from 39.9 to 42.6 but remains in neutral consolidation. MACD histogram worsened from -1.1034 to -2.8702, continuing bearish signals. Volume ratio at 0.89 indicates subdued activity and lack of direction. Current price $499.74 is below SMA200 $504.83 and EMA50 $514.64, indicating weakness. Weekly ADX at 20.1 suggests early trend formation, but -DI (37.8) is stronger than +DI (18.4). Overall, no strong buy/sell signals warranting a continued wait-and-see approach.
